title: FedReason: Large Language Models as Weight-Space Meta-Aggregators for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.08383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning servers combine client models with a fixed aggregation rule, and each rule in common use is designed for one kind of heterogeneity. We study whether a large language model (LLM) that inspects the client models can choose the rule itself, without any training on the server. In FedReason, the LLM is called every ten rounds. It analyses the weights by running code in a restricted server-side sandbox, sees only the printed results, may score a few candidates on a 500-image proxy set, and submits a short Python aggregation program. The server applies the program until the next call and falls back to FedAvg whenever its output is invalid. Full weight tensors never leave the server. We evaluated FedReason with Claude Opus 5.5 on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ResNet-18 under Dirichlet label skew, width-heterogeneous sub-models and Byzantine clients, in 168 runs against 14 baselines. Across 12 paired label-skew runs it beat Fed

translated_title: FedReason：将大语言模型用作异构联邦学习的权重空间元聚合器
translated_abstract: 联邦学习服务器使用固定的聚合规则来合并客户端模型，而每种常用规则都只针对某一类异构性设计。我们研究：一个能够查看客户端模型的大语言模型（LLM）能否自行选择聚合规则，且无需在服务器端进行任何训练。在FedReason中，LLM每十轮被调用一次；它通过在受限的服务器端沙箱中运行代码来分析权重，只能看到打印输出的结果，可以在一个包含500张图像的代理集上对少量候选规则进行评分，并提交一段简短的Python聚合程序。服务器应用该程序直至下一次调用，每当程序输出无效时则回退到FedAvg。完整的权重张量从不离开服务器。我们在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上使用ResNet-18，在Dirichlet标签偏斜、宽度异构子模型和拜占庭客户端的设定下，共进行了168次运行、对比14个基线方法来评估基于Claude Opus 5.5的FedReason。在12组配对的标签偏斜实验中，它胜过了Fed……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FedReason提出让大语言模型无需任何服务器端训练，通过受限沙箱定期分析客户端模型权重并自动生成自适应聚合程序，从而在标签偏斜、模型异构和拜占庭客户端等异构联邦学习场景中优于14种固定聚合规则基线。
en_tdlr: FedReason enables an LLM to act as a training-free meta-aggregator that periodically inspects client weights in a restricted server-side sandbox and writes its own aggregation program, adaptively outperforming 14 fixed-rule baselines under label skew, model heterogeneity, and Byzantine clients.
